FIELDS.NAME: Sparkle Clean Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sparkle Clean Solutions offers comprehensive janitorial and cleaning services tailored to various commercial settings, including office buildings, retail spaces, and educational institutions. Our operations focus on routine cleaning tasks such as dusting, vacuuming, mopping, and restroom sanitation, ensuring a clean and healthy environment for our clients. We maintain strict adherence to safety protocols and environmental regulations, utilizing standard cleaning agents and methods that prioritize the well-being of both our employees and the spaces we service. Each team member undergoes thorough background checks and ongoing training in safe practices to minimize risks and uphold our commitment to excellence. We operate a fleet of vehicles equipped for transporting our staff and supplies, maintaining proper documentation of vehicle maintenance and driver qualifications to ensure safe operations. At Sparkle Clean Solutions, we are dedicated to providing high-quality cleaning services while upholding the highest standards of safety and integrity.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 05/12/2023, Cause: Minor slip and fall incident resulting in employee medical expenses, Amount: $2,500.00, Status: Closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Commercial Safe, Class B, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: 24-hour video surveillance system with motion detection and yard fencing.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Sparkle Clean Solutions does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its janitorial and cleaning services. The operations primarily involve routine cleaning tasks using standard cleaning agents in commercial settings.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Sparkle Clean Solutions does not sponsor any athletic teams. Our focus remains on providing high-quality janitorial and cleaning services to various commercial clients.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our Operations Manager, John Smith.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Sparkle Clean Solutions has not had any applicant indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or any arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. We maintain strict integrity and compliance in our operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Sparkle Clean Solutions has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. All insurance policies have been maintained without interruption.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Sparkle Clean Solutions does not lease employees to or from other employers. All employees are directly employed by our company.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Sparkle Clean Solutions carries workers' compensation insurance as part of its commitment to employee safety and statutory compliance. This policy helps protect both the company and its employees in the event of workplace injuries.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Sparkle Clean Solutions does not own or operate any other business. Our sole focus is on providing janitorial and cleaning services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Sparkle Clean Solutions does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. All relevant coverage is currently represented under the existing policy.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Sparkle Clean Solutions is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations are strictly focused on providing janitorial and cleaning services in commercial settings.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Sparkle Clean Solutions does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our focus is solely on providing janitorial and cleaning services using our own equipment.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Sparkle Clean Solutions has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, maintaining a stable financial standing during that period.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Sparkle Clean Solutions does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals beyond standard cleaning agents used in janitorial services. All operations adhere to safety protocols and utilize environmentally compliant products.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Sparkle Clean Solutions does not engage in operations that present catastrophe exposure, as our services focus solely on routine janitorial tasks in non-hazardous environments. We maintain strict safety protocols to mitigate any potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Sparkle Clean Solutions has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our hiring practices include thorough background checks to ensure compliance and safety within our operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Sparkle Clean Solutions has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all fire safety regulations.
